Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: The request was accepted by Ecu M E_ NOT_ OK: The request was not accepted by Ecu M, a detailed error condition was sent to DET (see Error Codes below). Description Places a request for the POST RUN state. Requests can be placed by every user made known to the state manager at configuration time. Requests for RUN and POST RUN must be tracked independently (in other words: two independent variables). The service is intended for implementing AUTOSAR ports. Available via Ecu M.h
